workflow.title: Apple Intelligence models or ordinary clutter? Choose the cleanup scope first
workflow.primaryIntent: Decide whether unwanted Apple Intelligence/configuration changes or broader disk growth is the actual Mac maintenance job.
workflow.description: RemoveMacAI addresses unwanted Apple Intelligence and selected macOS settings; broader disk growth needs a different investigation. Start with feature dependencies, OS support and cleanup reversibility, not a promised number of gigabytes.
sections: Decide which AI-dependent features you still need
Separate a settings/profile change from file cleanup
Check macOS 27 and Apple silicon before considering v1.1.4
Review exact changes and distinguish Trash from immediate deletion
Do not confuse released models with immediately available space
Use wider storage investigation when the source of growth is unknown
workflow.interaction: Non-executing checklist: OS/architecture, features to retain, configuration vs storage goal, immediate-deletion acceptance. Do not generate removal commands or suggest bypassing security controls.
workflow.visualPlan: Official RemoveMacAI Overview after lead with vendor-data caveat; current-source Breathing Room Space later with full example-data banner/caption.

comparison.title: Breathing Room vs RemoveMacAI: investigation or de-bloating?
comparison.primaryIntent: Select between adjacent tools by task, rather than rank them as interchangeable cleaners.
comparison.leadDecision: For selective Apple Intelligence/configuration changes on the documented supported platform, RemoveMacAI is the documented fit. For wider storage/app activity investigation, consider Breathing Room, which we build, with its preview, Python and hosted-AI caveats.
comparison.format: Concise claim-linked matrix and two bounded decision paragraphs; no second alternatives route.

competitorAdvantages: Documents selective Apple Intelligence disable/model removal and profile export for MDM.
Free MIT app and CLI share undo history; review/dry-run controls are documented.
Documents configuration/background-updater controls beyond storage scanning.
competitorTradeoffs: v1.1.4 tagged requirements are macOS 27/Apple silicon; main docs differ.
Not notarized; no runtime or binary security audit performed.
AI-dependent features stop working; configuration undo is not guaranteed restoration of immediately deleted storage.
Disabling app updaters may trade background activity for responsibility to maintain updates (editorial caution, not tested outcome).
breathingRoomAdvantages: Source-based storage ownership/project views and grouped app/process monitoring suit a different investigation job.
Source includes activity history and constrained saved daily approvals, with limitations in capabilities.md.
breathingRoomTradeoffs: Preview, Python prerequisite, non-notarized release and unvalidated physical Intel runtime.
Hosted AI requires authentication/internet and may transmit relevant metadata; optional AI Care is paid.
No verified Apple Intelligence model-removal capability; do not recommend it for that specific task.
